facts.summary: UPLIFT missed primary endpoint, program wound down, 50% layoffs · Phase 1b/pivotal single-arm · UpRi in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the UPLIFT clinical trial of upifitamab rilsodotin (UpRi) did not meet its primary endpoint.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: UPLIFT clinical trial did not meet its primary endpoint
evidence.safety: Safety and tolerability data in UPLIFT were generally consistent with prior disclosures.
evidence.program_discontinued: Mersana’s restructuring plan includes a wind-down of UpRi-related development activities, including its UP-NEXT and UPGRADE-A clinical trials
